own_solution.law: Linear Zeeman shifts are ΔE = μB B(gP mP − gS mS), with μB = eħ/(2me) and allowed electric-dipole transitions Δm = 0, ±1. The largest absolute transition shift is (gP + gS)μB B/2 = 1.6675 μB B, so the outermost energy separation is 3.335 μB B. To first order, the wavelength separation is λ0²(3.335 μB B)/(hc), converting joules to electronvolts using the exact elementary charge.
assumptions: The stated linear Zeeman regime permits using the supplied level Landé factors.
The six observed components correspond to the allowed magnetic-sublevel transitions.
The wavelength shifts are treated to first order, as instructed.
